# ADR-002: Spwn is one stack of six apps on one ladder

**Status:** Accepted
**Date:** 2026-11-21
**Amended by:** [ADR-003](./003-the-three-spaces-are-the-structure-of-the-app.md) (the ladder)
**Amends:** [growth ADR-007](../../growth/decisions/007-spwn-is-the-ai-stack-that-abstracts-everything-but-you.md)

An agent leaves the status `Proposed`; only the owner writes `Accepted`.

## Decision

Six apps, in this order on one ladder: Machines, Agents, Wiki, Specs, Design, OS.
